_comment_european_clubs: The nine clubs in Europe this season, club short_name -> UCL | UEL | UECL. Maintained by hand. VERIFY THIS LIST -- it is seeded with a best guess.
_comment_european_fixtures: European kickoffs, maintained by hand -- the FPL API is Premier League only, so recovery_days cannot be derived without these. 'kickoff' accepts a date (2026-09-16) or a full ISO timestamp. 'competition' is optional and defaults to the club's entry in european_clubs. While this list is empty, every fixture reports recovery_days null and european_fixture_within_4_days false.
